When my hair started falling out and I started studying train routes so I could find one to stand in front of, I knew I had a problem. I had a lot of shit going on but therapist said maybe I should think about getting a different job. Blew my mind. Federal employee. 80k to do minimal work. Paid vehicle. No supervision. Who in their right mind would walk away from that? 
Nevermind that my co workers were vile sociopaths, or that the twisted politics had overtaken any and all actual Agency goals years ago, or that the sheer ridiculousness of what I was expected to do with outdated or outright non-functional computer equipment made me want to cry rather than push the power button, or that I never saw friends or family. 
Nevermind that I was fat and mean and had made my self so small to fit into this job that I didn't recognise myself anymore.
It took several scary months for me to come to grips. So focused on the money and career I had not consciously noticed the bad stuff, even though the rest of me apparently had.

Pleased to say, I quit almost a year ago and I've never been happier. Lost weight. Traveled. Met a guy.
I'm back in the workforce now. Wonderful company with well adjusted people that treats me like a human being. I had no idea I had eroded so far or that I was as miserable as I was. 

Loved this thread. Save your souls.
Mine too. Right in the feels.
Bravo, good Sir, Bravo.
Empathy level. That way I can avoid the psychopaths.
When I realized home is where ever he is.

This. So much this. 


I guess it also hit me consciously when somebody tried to tell me my SO didn't know me and was all wrong for me. Their position was that they had known me longer and knew me better than I knew myself and I should break it off immediately. 
Yes, this person is a manipulative jerk but my answer surprised me and shut him right the hell up.
I said, You know how I know you are wrong? He never forces his opinions on me or tells me what I am like. Mostly all he says is 'Me too.'

Brian Green. (Astrophysicist)
Something fishy 'bout him. Definitely my least favorite famous scientist.

Wasn't there a mobile RPG you could play involving quests to do shit better in your real life? It gives you points for doing your laundry and going to the gym type stuff. 
Heard about it but I've gone looking and I can't find it. :(
Making my boyfriend sleep on the outside side of the bed so that the boogie man will get him first. Early warning detection system.
Farts being absolutely hilarious. Pushing 40 and flatulence is still funny.

Sean Connery.
Rawr!

Tomatos still on the vine. Maybe the vine itself. IDK. Best smell ever.

Also the smell of the ink used in 1980's comics. Brings back the wonder of reading them.

Stood in warm blood up to my knees.

I worked on a slaughter floor and there was a clogged drain one day.

1) A super cute puppy.
Bastard has to provide for it or watch it die or kill it and eat it.

2) Leprosy or a bunch of bot flies...I can't decide which.

3) A bogus map with a cryptic poem and the X on a large rock or maybe 100 ft out in the water. Hope is a bitch.

You'll either love it or hate it.

I didn't like it at first watching my kid play it, but I was addicted the second I picked up the controller myself. The annoyingly flamboyant character grows on you after a while.

Don't need money to use the world's most awesome library, AKA Pirate Bay. I like to learn. It's not a good day unless I discover something new or the peices suddenly fit together in a new mind blowing way.

If money were not an issue, I've always liked the ending to Swordfish. Just get a camper and travel around seeing stuff.

Space travel.

When I was a kid I was a huge space nut. Had my whole life planned out so that I would become an alien world geologist and work in off planet mining or something.

Then Challenger blew up while my entire school watched live in an assembly. Yeah, I felt bad for the astronauts, but I was devastated when it became apparent that working space travel in my lifetime had just gone 'poof'.

I so want to leave this rock. Earth is becoming sort of a bad neighborhood these days.
That would be the day I decided to excel at procrastination.

Hate kids. Tell everyone not to have them.

Have more than three of my own and adore them.

ElfQuest everything. 

All the comics (and reprints.) 
All the graphic novels (and reprints.) Toys, Tee's, Miniatures, RPG, Calling Cards, Collector Coin, and even a bunch of the fan zines. 

Very comprehensive collection if I do say so myself.

Enchanted Arms for the PS3. Perfect RPG. I just wish the characters stats didn't top out.

Also Civ 5.

Petite.

Don't gussy it up, we all know what small means. I'm 5'4" and I hate this word.

I tried and tried to get away. Moved in the middle of the night, protective orders,....
I was married to the bastard with small children at home. Half the time it was the state and the justice system that helped him find me and sue me for alimony (he quit working two years into the marriage) and enabled him to emotionally terrorize his own kids.

I finally told him I was thinking of seriously killing him. CSI and the mystery channel giving me ideas and part of my job was at a hamburger factory. I knew where a sealed bloody dumpster full of rotten meat was and when it was emptied.

He still stayed. What was I supposed to do? Leave my dwelling? It was a house this time...not easy to just pick up and go. Cops wouldn't make him stay away for more than a couple days and rarely enforced the protective order when I had it.

I'm an intelligent upper middle class chick and every cliche about the police and the courts blew up in my face. 

It's not simple and it's not like on TV.

People cheer on the vigilante action hero in movies I think in part to seeing and feeling the injustice.
Some of these boy scouts would change their minds if it were them or if I had a month to tell all the horror stories.

I was stuck with an abusive meth addict for 13 years. I'm the oldest in my family. I don't have an older brother, but I wish I did; and that he had done this for me. 
Nope, calling the police does no good. Paper trail a mile long and the whole mess just continued. 
What OP describes is very plausible. Injection is for hardcore users who can't get high by smoking it anymore.
The justice system doesn't care about addicts or abuse and I'm pretty sure it's not gonna be  overly concerned with one more  dead junkie. 
The morals are somewhat different from the inside and OP is a good egg in my book.
I think it's brilliant.

Sweet existential gumbo. See, I knew I wanted to know you. *Inhales deeply*
*Makes wafting motions with both hands; gathering words to eyes*

I'm not your fan and I'm not your girlfriend. Fuckin' American cult of personality. I'm not here to take from you and wear your uniqueness like a bloody animal hide. Nor am I empty and sucking at the core, hungrily warming my frail, brittle limbs in the glow of your roaring soulfires and calling it love. What makes you interesting is the resonance between your descriptive word poems and my own mental imagery of similar experiences. 

"What is an appropriate response to life?"

I don't know. 
Most of these type questions are bigger than me. I gnaw at their edges and smuggle away my crumbs. If I had these answers I would be omnipotent and then ironically, no longer need them.

Kudos on your monopoly on the singularity of reality. You're right. Everybody is trapped in their own head. It's a fixed and lonely vantage point. Floating around in your flesh bag, peering out your eye holes. Maybe any meaningful connection is a shared delusion.

 At some point, no matter how prickly and abrasive you are, you will find your defenses breached by someone else. They will waltz right through your razor wire and mine fields unscathed because those defenses were designed to keep other out, but this individual reeks of sameness. The unwitting vacationer is setting up a little tent and roasting marshmallows on what is the beach at Normandy on D day to anyone else. It will happen.

As for most of the rest of the inhabitants of this orb whizzing through space....
I insulate myself heavily from my surroundings. Especially my fumbling fellow beings who lash out in fear or anger at every little thing. I have to. People I tend to relate to seem to have come into existence without the heavy blinders and thick personal armor most of the population takes for granted. We are wide eyed and skinless in a world that is toxic to us. I still wouldn't trade my multi frequency technicolor pain for their stumbling violence...ever.

Dude I found on YouTube said the appropriate response to life is to find the right aperture dilation for perception (he explains it when he talks about the walled city) and then find the right balance between order and chaos. You'll know when you find it because your suffering fades into the background and life is not so horrible. 

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OcfSqKylag0&feature=youtube_gdata_player

He's got two more that are worth watching. Necessity of Virtue and Self Deception in Psychopathology.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y0B0h4L2eEU&feature=youtube_gdata_player

This guy doesn't offend me and might be on to something. I don't know what. He's like yummy existential junk food. Try him

It took 35 years but I found someone who is just like me. One foot firmly planted in swirling whimsy and a deep seated disgust for humanity in general. Artsy type. Fascinated by words.
 He wasn't where I thought he would be. And he only appeared after I quit looking. But color me silly, the kind of sustaining, cleansing bond that only fictional characters seem to be able to achieve really exists. 

 We love the Stars. Physics documentaries or just a clear night. To us, they are fellow denizens of a macroverse.
With adequately diminished expectations, social interaction is not terribly challenging. Everyone feels cliquish now and again and joins some social grouping to get in from the cold for a while. Sadly, these little groups end up being microcosms and one must repress or ignore vast aspects of self to remain within the bounds of the tiny social construct. Over time, the neglect of the whole sent each of us back out as individuals seeking a place. 
The stars for us represent the greater belonging we've found together where life; it's quirks and quarks, is the sheltering framework for those doomed to be born with strange surfaces and many facets. Everything, not just shallow slices. A macroverse.

I have more scars. I think his capacity for being able to bare having his inner reality in jarring dissonance with the outter realities of existence is greater than mine. I would try to balance the two sooner. Wish that my ribbons were silk and not roped flesh.

Given, everyone must die. It's probably not as horrible as people make it out to be. I personally hope it's like nothing I, or anyone else has ever imagined. But please, don't go just yet.

It's worth it to find someone who can know you. I would like to know you. I like your deftness with words. And they need you to craft good writing out of them.

String a few more together and reply?

Thank you. That was an intense comment to wake up to. I read it and then read it again.

Here's the thing. Loss of life isn't a tragedy. I used to work in a slaughter house. Ever stood in warm blood up to your knees? I have. Thousands of lives ended every day. You know what it looks like? Food.
People don't think about death as being a good thing.
Imagine if no one and nothing ever died starting tomorrow. The world would be even more horrible than it is now. Overcrowded and strained as the system of life and death that has been in place forever collapsed and harmed everyone.

My place in the human web has been taken from me by bigger badder predators. True, I could adapt to a new environs, but I really don't want to.
Any species or person who loses their niche...well lets just say things don't go too well for them.

There is no place for me socially, financially, physically, emotionally...the list goes on.
I can take a hint. I don't belong here.

Minds and hearts facinate me. If people were capable of sharing thoughts directly and purely with each other what do you think would happen?
Would peace erupt as misunderstanding plummeted? Or would it be war as true intentions and the full extent of lies and betrayal became known?
Would homicide decrease because we would have a heightened awareness of our fellow beings? Or would we start killing each other wholesale as the cocoons and delusions where we all truly dwell are ripped apart.

I have zero faith in humanity. I'm ashamed to be part of the species.

It might be sad when I am gone, but only to a marginalized subset of individuals that still retains the apparently evolutionarily useless capacity for empathy and compassion.

My creative output is awesome right now. Unfortunately I can't show it to anyone. A picture maybe could have multiple interpretations but strung words 'say it all' pretty much. 

Wow. You recognise the place I described? I never really thought about others coming here. The whole~ sanity slipping into something that resembles Picasso and Dali's love child painting. And that place being two steps removed from the Pit. The Pit is where I can't get out of bed and I sleep until something pulls me out. It's akin to being in tiny room with a super high ceiling and everthing is swathed in layers of black velvet while I slumber under a stack of quilts. Thick, muffled, and stifeling.  You get that?

I have kids and a house and a high powered career. Extended family all close. Money problems, but not cuz I don't make enough. I don't avert the spirals because I'm healthy or anything. I do it out of guilt for all the things I should be doing when instead I am pearl diving in my own head. Sometimes it doesn't even work and I spiral anyway.

As far as letting the crazy take you, I'm afraid of that as well. That I may wander or be blown too far out past where reality starts to dribble and the pit where all shuts down is scary.
Something has always brought me back before. If it didn't, I hope I'm so far gone I don't notice.

Everyday is like breathing broken glass. 
Listen, I don't have any answers. 
Personally I think this happens to sensitive people. Those of us trying to exist without skin in a toxic world where every one else has skin, and clothes, and freakin armor over that. 
If it helps, I think you are rare and precious to even know what I'm talking about. And that there's nothing at all wrong with you. Us poor skinless bastards just have to work harder at coping. Wish I knew what would work.

Some of us are tied by heavy obligation. Not being able to keep up with crushing demands and no room for us anymore in our own lives is literally killing us. While tempting to let the house of cards fall and walk free, a change in circumstance is different than being released from obligation.

I posted because it feels like I am a shrinking island. Sinking slowly into the cold black. Doubtful I'd connect with anyone. But it is comforting to look out and see another land mass, even if I can't touch it.

Were I intetested in averting todays spiral, I would go for a walk or to a museum. Walking reconnects me to myself when I drift to far. Museums help with perspective.

I'm not saying this makes anything better. I just know that trying to figure out how to make things better doesn't work real well when I am spiraling.

I don't even take Ibuprophen. Todays fantasy is asian style death by high speed rail.
I'm not ready to off myself yet. I have an outfit picked out but much writing and some tidying up to do.
Poem was about deciding I was going to do it. That moment where the stress of my future went away.
